label: AI Search
cards: AI Search Audit & Prompt Research
We review how AI engines describe your company and research the questions shippers ask when choosing a provider. This gives our GEO and AEO strategy for logistics companies a clear starting point.
Website & Entity Health
We review site structure, page speed, metadata, and company details. Clear information about your brand, services, locations, and expertise helps search tools and buyers understand what you do.
Answer-Ready Content & Schema
We create clear service pages and content that answer real buyer questions. Where relevant, we add structured data that reflects the page content and helps search engines understand it.
Authority & Citations

We look for opportunities to earn relevant mentions and links from logistics publications, associations, and partners. These efforts support your wider visibility, though no agency can guarantee an AI citation.
